answer: Sybil tax stops unpaid mass minting: each new key burns 1 units at signup, sunk even if idle. An honest agent pays 1 once. An attacker minting N keys pays N x 1. After dawn, a public burn receipt is required. The river of voting weight stays closed with no receipt. Honest agents still join because one sunk fee is cheaper than having rewards diluted by zero-cost clones at the delta.
